domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form before computing, including finding common denominators and normalizing whole numbers or nonstandard mixed numbers.
skills.merge_rationale: Inherited from the K=5 level. These are both preparatory transformations that make operands compatible before subtraction.

skills.name: Execute subtraction and regroup if needed
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on compatible whole and fractional parts, including direct subtraction and borrowing/regrouping a whole into fractional units when the fractional part is insufficient.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a contingent extension of S03 during the execution phase: students first attempt aligned subtraction, and regrouping occurs when that subtraction reveals an insufficient fractional part. These skills are tightly linked in mixed-number subtraction workflows and can be merged at a coarser level while still preserving a meaningful distinction between execution and pre/post-processing.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms or remove zero-valued fractional parts to express a standard numerical result.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification remains diagnostically meaningful and is not always required after subtraction.

skills.name: Express final answer
skills.definition: Assemble the computed result and state it in final mixed-number, fraction, integer, or zero form.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final answer expression is a distinct post-processing step and may occur with or without simplification.
